title: pelargonium clypeatum
intro: Pelargonium clypeatum, commonly known as Oat Leaf Geranium or Cape Oat, is a species of flowering plant in the family Geraniaceae. It is known for its leaves resembling oats, which has led to its common name. The health benefits of Pelargonium clypeatum include its potential to reduce fever, alleviate coughs, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, such as geraniol and linalool, that exhibit anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties.
